Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Mendelevium (Md) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.

LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests naturally for the posture, relaxed and empty.

Her element — mendelevium: a synthetic metal first made in 1955 by striking about a billion atoms of einsteinium with alpha particles, the first element created and identified one atom at a time, only seventeen of them in the first experiments, with a building's fire-alarm bell wired to ring each time a single atom split; named, with special permission in the middle of a cold war, for the chemist who in 1869 laid out the elements like cards in a game of patience to build the periodic table, leaving blank squares for elements not yet found and foretelling what they would be like — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.
